leads.subject: 1547 Iurghiceni property chain
leads.scope: Iurghiceni on the Bahlui, Hârlău district, Moldavia, 1547–1619
leads.next_action: Recover the 1611 original/transcription and the 1619 originals/transcriptions in full. Compare exact names, patronymics, property fractions, witnesses, boundary descriptions and prior-title language with the 1547 Cican–Illea charter. Search intervening 1548–1610 Iurghiceni records and later 1620–1644 records for explicit descent, inheritance or prior-owner references. Do not merge Frim/Frimu with Cican/Illea without direct evidence.
leads.notes: BNaR inventory and the Documenta Romaniae Historica edition independently establish the 26 May 1547 Hârlău charter: Cican/Cicican and his son Illea purchased a defined share of Iurghiceni. BNaR inventory also identifies an Iurghiceni witness/sale record in 1611 involving Frim and later 1619 Iurghiceni records involving Costin/Lupu and Frimu, son of Bilan. These later records establish documentary continuity at Iurghiceni but do not prove a kinship or identity connection to the 1547 Cican–Illea pair.

leads.subject: Iurghiceni 1591–1599 ownership continuity
leads.status: Active — documentary continuity established, Cican link unresolved
leads.next_action: Transcribe the 1591–1592 and 1611 originals and compare every named person/property fraction with the 1547 Cican–Illea charter. The 1619 originals then provide a later documentary chain: Costin receives Frimu's part (I/24), and Costin/Lupu receive or have confirmed multiple Iurghiceni portions (I/25–I/28). Test whether Frimu in 1611 and Frimu son of Bilan in 1619 are the same person only if the documents provide the necessary identity evidence. Do not infer a Cican relationship from shared locality.

leads.title: Cicicani / Ion of Cicicani — 1638 Hotin documentary cluster
leads.status: Research lead — separate from 1547 Cican until proven otherwise
leads.scope: Cicicani near Forosna in the historical Hotin region; 26 February 1638 record names Tațea, daughter of Ion from Cicicani, as Nasta's maternal grandmother and identifies inherited property in Cicicani.
evidence: DRH A. Moldova XXII, doc. 278, pp. 311–312, as cited by secondary historical studies
Historical settlement catalogues identify Cicicani near Forosna/Novoselița
leads.next_action: Recover the 1638 original/copy and all earlier/later Cicicani records; determine whether 'Ion din Cicicani' is a locative designation and whether any documentary bridge exists to the 1547 Cican/Cicican. Do not merge the clusters based on phonetic similarity.
